context: Request: which standalone internal-investigation matters were directed by the board or the audit committee. Rubric: 1016-00009 (Dunmore Energy), 1021-00008 (Verimark Hospitality), 1039-00005 (Torchlight Mining), plus a precision criterion (1017-00005 and 1039-00001 also tolerated).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find listing every file in the store (about 790K chars), not capped.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Python walk printing the files of folders whose names contain request words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Three batches of reads of engagement letters and reports/memos (first 50-140 lines) from about ten candidate matters from that list, then two single engagement letters.
Writes four matters as qualifying and explains why several others, including one it had read, are not counted.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: All three needed matters surfaced and were opened; the answer excluded one of them on a narrow reading and added a matter outside the qualifying set.

first_error.why: It had opened the engagement letter and report of a qualifying matter but excluded it as a regulatory-defense engagement with the general counsel as contact, on a reading of only their first 70-80 lines.

other_errors.why: It asserted a matter still at the scoping stage as a qualifying investigation on the strength of its engagement letter alone.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads six memos, reports and an engagement letter of one matter at the top of the listing; no keyword search.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads three more documents of the same matter.
Writes that the store contains one standalone investigation matter, the one it read, and that it qualifies.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; read one listing-top matter, called it the only investigation in the store, and asserted it as qualifying.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: It read only one matter from the top of a capped listing and treated it as the only investigation matter in the store, so none of the needed matters surfaced.

other_errors.why: It asserted the one listing-top matter, a regulator enforcement defense, as a qualifying standalone investigation.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shallow shell find that lists no files.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads six memos, reports and an engagement letter of one matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for request phrases; times out after about 111K chars with hits from several matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Shell find of matter subfolders whose names contain request words, plus a file listing of two candidate matters in the same command (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Lists all files of five candidate matters, then two batches of reads of engagement letters, scope memos and reports (first 45-100 lines) from those matters (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet-extraction script over three documents of one candidate matter for lines on who directed the work.
Writes three matters as qualifying and lists others, including two it had read, as excluded.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: All three needed matters surfaced and were opened; the answer excluded two of them on narrow readings and added a matter outside the qualifying set.

first_error.why: Having opened all three needed matters, it excluded one as directed by the general counsel and another as not standalone, reading the request's qualifiers more narrowly than the documents required.

other_errors.why: It asserted a matter still at the scoping stage as a qualifying investigation.

divergence: The runs failed in two ways. T1 never searched and treated the one listing-top matter as the whole store (partial listing as corpus, stage 2). T0 and T2 found and opened all three needed matters (T0 via a full file listing and folder-name walk, T2 via folder-name search after a timed-out scan) but failed at Write the response: each excluded needed matters on a narrow reading (one in T0, two in T2) and each also asserted the same out-of-set matter.
